shellCommands.command: for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo ==== $f; cat "$f"; done
git diff -- package.json; git ls-files; test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || true
rm -r pages .next; rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; npm run build

git status --short; git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css; test -d pages && echo pages-present || echo pages-absent; grep -R -n -E 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps' app components lib || true
